title: Martha’s Vineyard Family Campground

services.name: Campsite
services.desc: Check out our map here so you can get to and from all of our awesome attractions! Want to see what time the recreation opens? How about when you can do a little shopping at our camp store? View all of our hours for attractions, and facilities here! Part of what makes your camping trip so special is that getting here is an adventure in itself! Since our campground is only accessible by boat or plane, we’ve gathered important information to help make your arrival as smooth as possible. Whether you’re traveling by car to the ferry, taking a bus to the ferry, flying in, or arriving by private boat, you’ll find everything you need to know-including ferry service details and transportation tips.
